verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the instruction to append `--region <aws-region>` to CLI commands. This implies IVS resources are created in a user-chosen AWS region, but it is a single thin mention with no statement about where stream, recording or chat data actually resides. Docs also say ingest happens automatically at a location near the streamer rather than one the user picks. Missing for 10: documented list of IVS regions, explicit data-residency guarantees for stored data such as recordings and chat, documented control over ingest and processing location, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
